Interface SyncUserResolver<U>

Type Parameters:
U - The type of the user object used by the application
public interface SyncUserResolver<U>
Resolves the currently authentication user for a controller call and gets the ID of a user. This interface allows applications using Synq to use their own user objects for authentication and querying.
